QuestInfo.name: Vicky's Standards
QuestInfo.0: A girl named Vicky is looking for you. Go find her.
QuestInfo.1: You must find the #t4034001# items. Maybe there are some quality claws nearby?
QuestInfo.2: You got #t4034001# items for Vicky. Now you can venture forth!

0.msg: You have to pay a tax if you want to board my ship. I wonder if you even have anything worthwhile.

2.msg: Tch, you're still just a kid. Show me something valuable if you want a ride.

4.msg: They sound disgusting but whatever, they could be valuable. Bring them to me!

0.msg: I really want to see them! Especially if they're made of gold!

no.0: You really are just a kid!

1.msg: Ugh, what's with this smell? It's so disgusting, I can feel my nails rotting!

3.msg: Don't you even DARE think about getting on my ship before you get a shower!

4.msg: Oh? You'll let me on your ship when I'm cleaned up? Woo!

5.msg: Ugh, these claws are giving me an awful headache.

npc.0: Do we have to wait for the #t4034001#s to grow or something?
